comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Can be produced at the Printing Press of any Industrial Revolution city while it's in Boom status (Manchester is permanently in this state) and is at a certain level of development. Requirements are:

Linguistics R10
Management Technique R8
Paper x20
Adhesive Oil x10

"Tuniit" should refer to Arctic language, IE the kind spoken in Russia. (Oddly, the recipe description says the dictionary covers "Japanese and Korean", but Altaic already translates Korean.)

comments.author: Aguirre
comments.body: Went to Manchester with the requisite skill levels and materials. The dictionary recipes are not showing - only the translation notes. Invested 5m as well. What else might I be missing?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Apologies. I neglected to update after my original post that this recipe only appears at the six national Industrial Ports; never at Manchester.

Further, that nation must achieve a certain level of development or else some of its recipes will not appear even when Revolution state is entered. Investment does not matter.

The ports are:

Bilbao (Spain)
Viana do Castelo (Portugal)
Le Havre (France)
Portsmouth (England)
Cataro (Venice)
Rotterdam (The Netherlands)

You can check their status at any Quest Mediator. Cheers.
